The re-solver was generalized to three table kinds selected by data-complete: 'volume' (cylinder π-coefficients, existing), 'base-volume' (literal B·h, no radius inference) and 'capacity-remaining' (full=B·h in cm³=ml, remaining=full−existing with L/ml conversion), plus an opt-in data-decimal="1" flag that relaxes the integer/whole-radius guards for decimal/approx/capacity rows while still requiring unique determination, relational consistency and non-negative capacities. All six pages (25/26/29/32/33/34) are now tagged with inputs-only data-given/data-solve and re-solved; coverage rose from 6 tables/27 rows to 12 tables/47 rows. Break-and-revert negative tests confirmed the new paths catch a negative remaining, a declared-given drift, and (with the decimal flag removed) non-integer and non-whole-radius results. Full QA green.

Root cause: the Rubik/Heebo font stack is not bundled, so CI falls back to a different, taller/wider font than Windows and page-41's dense formula/example lines wrapped past the 297mm box. Fixed by hardening the three tight new pages: page-41 widened the anchor text column (SVG 60mm→48mm) and reduced the formula/example font sizes, plus shrank Q3/Q4 work boxes h12→h10 and tightened their section margins; page-42 and page-43 shrank their oversized axial/Pythagoras figures (150mm→130mm, 116mm→100mm) and tightened figure margins, and page-43 work boxes h16→h14. Natural-height remeasurement (height:auto override) shows all pages 39-49 now sit at least 62px below the 1123px A4 limit — page-41 33→89px, page-42 33→72px, page-43 23→76px slack — comfortably absorbing CI's font-metric delta (which was under ~50px even on the worst page).

2026-10-09: the SSOT audit (§16 with §4/§19) found that the work-grid ruling (.work and the --a4-work-extra ::after) and the shaded table-header/anchor fills are drawn purely as CSS background gradients/colours with no print-color-adjust, so Chrome's default Save-as-PDF (Background graphics OFF) dropped the 'משבצות' ruling — leaving only an empty bordered box — while browser-qa masked this by forcing printBackground:true.
